title: File:Lamprey mouth (28004177415).jpg
art: U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service - Midwest Region
desc:
Sea lamprey tongue acts like a drill, rasping through fish scales and skin. They feed on body fluids of fish by secreting an enzyme that prevents blood from clotting, similar to how a leech feeds off its host.
Photo by USFWS.
